description: Geografski sustav popisa odašiljača - WMS is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ekarta.hakom.hr. WMS service that was created on the basis of the Geographic System List of Transmitters and contains technical and spatial data on radio transmitters divided by radio services and technologies. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Transmitter List Geographical System - WMS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GSPO, inspiregeoportal, radijske postaje, HAKOM, UMTS, mrežna usluga pregleda. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
